script: Astronomers have found more than 5,000 planets orbiting other stars. They are called exoplanets. The first one around a Sun-like star was found in 1995. Most stars in our galaxy probably have at least one planet. Some could be rocky worlds at the right distance for liquid water. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
